title: Resort Club Memberships Payment Terms: Grace Period, Late Fee and Non-Payment Threshold
content:
Three figures govern how long an invoice on a Resort Club Memberships account may stay unpaid: the grace period before an invoice is late, the late fee charged on a late invoice, and the number of days after invoicing at which an unpaid invoice terminates the membership.

| Membership level | Grace period after invoicing (calendar days) | Late fee per late invoice (USD) | Days after invoicing after which an unpaid invoice terminates the membership (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 10 | 25.00 | 90 |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 10 | 25.00 | 90 |
| Spa Club Membership | 10 | 25.00 | 90 |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 10 | 25.00 | 90 |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 10 | 25.00 | 90 |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 10 | 50.00 | 90 |

## Terms explained

1. **Grace period.** An invoice may be paid within 10 calendar days of its entry date at every level; an invoice still unpaid once those days have passed is late.
2. **Late fee.** The fee charged on a late invoice is 25.00 at every level except the Founders Resort Club Membership, where it is 50.00.
3. **Non-payment threshold.** At every level the threshold is 90 calendar days after invoicing.

The grace period and the non-payment threshold are both counted in calendar days.
